title: improv·artist · collage (Wangechi Mutu)
mutation_directive: improv artist: collage via Wangechi Mutu

improv_extras.practice: ink and collage hybrids; mythic figures, Afrofuturist body

v1.feedback: Strong concept-to-code: Voronoi patches mapped to anatomical regions genuinely evoke Mutu's collage layering, and the staggered gather animation gives each fragment its own arrival cadence. The earth-tone palette (umber, sienna, bone, olive, wine) is exactly right. Two refinements: the body's z-thickness is only 0.25 units, making the figure read as a flat cutout even at oblique drag — consider giving torso and hip patches 0.3–0.5 z-spread so the form gains subtle volume under orbit; and the Voronoi boundary shimmer (patch centres breathing ±0.06) is too subtle at this camera distance to read as collage-edge tension — doubling the amplitude to ~0.12 and adding a faint edge-darkening line (vEdge < 0.15 → darken by 15%) would sell the torn-paper seam.

v2.feedback: The anatomical ellipsoid approach gives a recognizable standing figure, and the staggered gather arc genuinely channels Mutu's collage-assembly feeling — strong concept-to-form mapping. The earth palette is excellent. Two improvements: (1) the 18 overlapping ellipsoids will read as a soft pointillist mannequin rather than torn collage patches — consider using flat polygon quads or triangulated Voronoi cells instead of individual particles so the 'torn paper' materiality comes through, and (2) the edge shimmer is too subtle to convey patch boundaries; sharper alpha falloff at patch borders (step function rather than smoothstep) and slight z-offset between adjacent patches would sell the layered-collage depth that defines Mutu's surface.
